observations: Two manual drum pumps with brass-colored heads and metal handles.
Two white plastic lids with central holes.
A watermark 'QUESTMARK ENTERPRISES POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
The items are photographed on a tiled floor.

claims.evidence: The pump head size is not clearly legible in photo 0.
The diameter of the pump head opening is not clearly legible in photo 0.
The pump heads and handles in photo 0 are silver-colored metal.
No gasket is visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: The pump may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the pump being operated to draw fluid.

risks.risk: The pump may be a different capacity (e.g., 100L) than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the pump head with a measuring tape or a reference object.

risks.risk: The rubber gasket may be missing or degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the gasket attached to the pump head.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the pump being operated to confirm it works.
Photo of the pump head with a measuring tape to verify the 70mm size.
Photo of the rubber gasket if present.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
